title: Adventures of Jackie Chan
description: Unlock the special features hub for the legendary cartoon! Choose between Season 1 (The Twelve Talismans) and Season 2 (The Demon Portals), view full episode listings, and filter by magical talisman powers.

title: Dexter's Laboratory
description: Dexter, a boy genius, invents amazing creations in his secret laboratory, but is constantly interrupted by his hyperactive sister Dee Dee and his rival Mandark. Broadcasted in Tamil on Cartoon Network.

title: Spider-Man: The Animated Series
description: Peter Parker balances his personal life in college with his responsibilities as the web-slinging superhero Spider-Man, defending New York from iconic supervillains. The Sun TV Tamil dub was a massive sensation.

title: Ben 10
description: Ben Tennyson, a 10-year-old boy, discovers a mysterious alien watch called the Omnitrix that allows him to transform into ten different extraterrestrial superheroes. The ultimate 2000s hit in Tamil.

title: Tom and Jerry
description: The classic, chaotic, and slapstick rivalry between Tom the cat and Jerry the mouse. Guaranteed laughs for every Tamil household, spanning multiple generations.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description: By the power of Grayskull! Prince Adam transforms into the mighty warrior He-Man to defend the realm of Eternia and the secrets of Castle Grayskull from the evil Skeletor. A massive Sun TV favorite in the late 90s.

title: Pokémon
description: Ash Ketchum and his loyal partner Pikachu travel across various regions, catching pocket monsters, battling Gym Leaders, and chasing the dream of becoming a Pokémon Master. Relive the craze on Cartoon Network Tamil.

title: The Powerpuff Girls
description: Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup are three kindergarten-aged superheroes created by Professor Utonium using sugar, spice, and everything nice, plus the accidental Chemical X. Broadcasted in Tamil on Cartoon Network.

title: Dragon Ball Z
description: Goku and his friends defend Earth against alien conquerors, androids, and magical creatures. Famous for the long power-ups, Super Saiyan transformations, and epic battles. A highly requested Cartoon Network classic.

title: Little Krishna
description: The marvelous adventures of the playful and heroic Little Krishna in Vrindavan, defending his town against dangerous demons sent by King Kansa. A visually rich 3D animation that was incredibly popular on Chutti TV.

title: X-Men: The Animated Series
description: A team of mutant superheroes fights for peace and equality in a world that fears and hates them. Broadcasted on Jetix and Sun TV with intense Tamil voice acting that fans still remember today.

title: Codename: Kids Next Door
description: Five ten-year-old kids operate from a high-tech treehouse, fighting adult tyranny and silly rules using self-made 2x4 technology. A major part of the early 2000s Cartoon Network Tamil schedule.
